Lista de Empaque

A shipping document itemizing package contents, weights, and dimensions for cargo handling, customs inspection, and delivery confirmation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Lista de Empaque?

In this glossary, Lista de Empaque refers to: A shipping document itemizing package contents, weights, and dimensions for cargo handling, customs inspection, and delivery confirmation.

How is Lista de Empaque used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Los transitarios requieren una lista de empaque detallada para verificar el contenido de la carga y facilitar el despacho de aduanas."

Why does Lista de Empaque matter in logistics?

Lista de Empaque matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Lista de Empaque?

Lista de Empaque is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Lista de Empaque belong to?

In this glossary, Lista de Empaque is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A shipping document itemizing package contents, weights, and dimensions for cargo handling, customs inspection, and delivery confirmation.

Operational example

Freight forwarders require a detailed packing list to verify cargo contents and facilitate customs clearance.

Localized term
